slice.explanation: 沿第 0 轴（layer_slot）取当前层组的第 1 层：self-attention 对应全局层 2p，p 从 0 开始。K 与 V 各自读取对应层，保留 batch、head、prefix sequence、head dimension。
沿第 0 轴（layer_slot）取当前层组的第 1 层：self-attention 对应全局层 2p，p 从 0 开始。K 与 V 各自读取对应层，保留 batch、head、prefix sequence、head dimension。
沿第 0 轴（layer_slot）取当前层组的第 2 层：cross-attention 对应全局层 2p+1，p 从 0 开始。K 与 V 各自读取对应层，保留 batch、head、prefix sequence、head dimension。
沿第 0 轴（layer_slot）取当前层组的第 2 层：cross-attention 对应全局层 2p+1，p 从 0 开始。K 与 V 各自读取对应层，保留 batch、head、prefix sequence、head dimension。
沿最后一轴（action width）取前 {DOUT} 个分量，保留 batch 与 action horizon。当前内部 {DIN} 维动作输出为公开 {DOUT} 维。
slice.identity_explanation: 当前 {DIN}→{DOUT} 覆盖整个轴，数值与形状保持不变。

stages.label: Vision encoder
stages.description: The saved feature contract is 256 × 256; policy preprocessing produces the executed 512 × 512 input that determines 1024 patch tokens.

stages.label: VLM prefix encoder
stages.description: Connector images and language share the first mask block; the trailing projected state token starts the second. Sixteen VLM layers fill fixed prefix K/V.

stages.label: Action flow decoder
stages.description: Each flow step keeps xₜ separate from the immutable prefix cache and executes eight ordered self-attention/cross-attention layer pairs.

stages.label: Public action contract
stages.description: After the flow (ten steps by artifact default), the policy slices the internal 32-wide chunk to the saved six-dimensional public action contract.
